freshGenerationPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: BRAND NEW standalone Kalistar character illustration, portrait 4:5. Generate a completely fresh painting with a new pose, composition, anatomy and lighting, NOT another retouch of the earlier standing-on-stairs soldier. Illustration only, no card frame.

SUBJECT AND MOMENT
One terrifying skeletal SOLDIER OF CRYPTOWN in complete black and violet military armor. He is stepping out of the shadow of a ruined city gate toward an unseen intruder, caught at the moment of recognition: head tilted slightly downward, gaze aimed straight at the viewer, weight committed to one forward armored boot, shoulders set with disciplined murderous stillness. A veteran sentinel, not a king, theatrical villain or mannequin. The dread comes from his implacable focused presence, not gore. Real skull face visible inside the helmet, believable bone anatomy, dark eye sockets holding two small concentrated violet embers. One head, two arms, two legs.

KALISTAR ART DIRECTION IS THE FIRST PRIORITY
Detailed narrative fantasy PAINTING with distinctly visible confident brush marks, broken painterly edges, broad angular color planes and selective precise detail. Materials built through painted strokes and layered color, with worn steel, chipped dark finish, frayed purple cloth and rubbed leather. Face, main hand and sword are legible focal points; background is simplified and atmospheric. The warm worn-material expressiveness of Kalistar's Momo and the grave painted sculptural volumes of Valazar guide this style. No smooth render, no photoreal photograph, no airbrushed surfaces, no plastic, no anime, no uniform digital noise overlay. Color palette: blackened steel, deep faded violet fabric, restrained aged copper seams, ivory bone, cold gray setting and small warm environmental highlights. Textured surface richness, not excessive micro-detail.

ARMOR AND TERRIFYING HELMET
Complete fitted protective armor from beneath the jaw to the boots: closed breastplate, shoulder and arm plates, articulated five-finger gauntlets on BOTH hands, armored waist, thighs, knees, greaves and boots. No exposed ribs, finger bones or leg bones. Lean powerful soldier silhouette, not bulky powered armor. A LITTLE futuristic lost craftsmanship: precise beveled plate joins, recessed fasteners, compact ingenious mechanical articulations; retain fantasy military tailoring and a worn deep-violet half-cloak and modest cloth panels. Never a modern tactical uniform or neon bodysuit.

The helmet must be mythical, imposing and frightening: a heavy, sculpted black iron funerary WAR HELM, low deeply overhanging angular brow and strong faceted cheek guards, framing rather than concealing the actual skull. A broad compact double-ridged shell swept slightly backward, subtle severe stepped geometry, a little patinated copper, almost like an armored shadow enclosing his face. His sockets sit deep under the brow; the lower face remains visible without a cheerful exaggerated grin. Original military relic design, elegant but brutal and credible. NO fan-shaped crest, no plumage, wings, feathers, horns, antlers, animal resemblance, tall mitre, pointed bishop hat, decorative crown, excessive spikes, extra skull ornaments or floating halo.

KALISTEL AND LIGHT: CHEST ONLY
One luminous faceted VIOLET KALISTEL structurally set into the FRONT OF THE HIGH ARMORED COLLAR, immediately beneath the jaw, not a necklace and not a chest-center gem. It visibly feeds five slender paired rib-shaped luminous channels built into the breastplate, suggesting a spectral ribcage. Bright lilac cores and amethyst edges illuminate nearby worn black metal. Clearly brilliant and magical yet controlled: preserve dark plate surfaces between ribs and restrained local reflections. The collar gem is the source. This skeletal light pattern is ONLY ON THE CHEST, stopping above the waist. No illuminated bones on hands, arms, abdomen, pelvis, legs or feet; no literal skeleton print, no whole-body outline, no huge aura or electric particles.

SIGNATURE SWORD
A beautiful, formidable long straight sword with coherent blade, guard, grip and pommel on one axis. Dark intricately forged compact guard with restrained copper trim, sharpened pale metal cutting edges and a thin recessed violet energy channel along a single straight blade. Long elegant cutting proportions, not a giant slab, curved blade or cartoon weapon. His sword hand firmly encloses the grip just below the guard. Hold it LOW diagonally across the foreground, hilt beside his hip and the entire blade extending down toward the opposite lower side, without hiding the collar or luminous ribs. His other armored hand is naturally held slightly away from his body, ready to act. Both hands physically coherent, no extra fingers. Entire sword tip and helmet comfortably inside the image, no bending or shortening to fit.

SCENE AND COMPOSITION
Fresh low-angle but non-distorted full-figure portrait. Soldier fills the central frame with both boots visible and enough breathing space above helmet and around blade. The moment feels lived rather than a posed armor showcase. Sparse ruined Cryptown gate, massive weathered stone and a few almost forgotten metal structural elements, a calm gray-violet sky or dark recessed opening behind his silhouette, wet paving underfoot. Just one faint warm light source in the background motivates a warm edge, balancing cool ambient light and the violet Kalistel. No crowded city skyline, armies, banners, clutter, rows of skulls or distracting props. Background strongly subordinate, textured but quiet. Black armor remains readable, do not crush everything into darkness.
No text, logo, signature, watermark, UI, stats or card border.
